import time
from z3 import *
o = Optimize()
x = Int('x')
o.add(x >= 0, x <= 10)
o.push()
o.minimize(x)
print(o.check(), o.lower(o.objectives()[0]))
o.pop()
print("objectives after pop:", o.objectives())
